WITH w AS (
 SELECT r.fiscal_period p, o.fulfilment_type ft, f.net_amount, f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, cast(f.sale_ts_utc as date) utc_date
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
 JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar r ON f.sale_date BETWEEN r.period_start_date AND r.period_end_date
 WHERE (f.channel_code='WB' OR f.channel_id IN (2,3)) AND r.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND r.fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8
), rt AS (
 SELECT w.p, w.ft, sum(rl.refund_net) refund_net
 FROM fact_return_line rl JOIN w ON w.sales_line_id=rl.sales_line_id GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT w.p, w.ft, sum(net_amount) net, count(*) n, sum(case when sale_date<>utc_date then 1 else 0 end) datediff, max(rt.refund_net) refunds
FROM w LEFT JOIN rt ON rt.p=w.p AND rt.ft=w.ft GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH web AS (
 SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, f.net_amount, o.fulfilment_type ft
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
 WHERE f.channel_code='WB' OR f.channel_id IN (2,3)
), s AS (
 SELECT r.fiscal_period p, sum(net_amount) tot, sum(CASE WHEN ft='click_and_collect' THEN net_amount END) cc
 FROM web JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar r ON sale_date BETWEEN r.period_start_date AND r.period_end_date
 WHERE r.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND r.fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8 GROUP BY 1
), rf AS (
 SELECT r.fiscal_period p, sum(rl.refund_net) tot, sum(CASE WHEN web.ft='click_and_collect' THEN rl.refund_net END) cc
 FROM fact_return_line rl JOIN web ON web.sales_line_id = rl.sales_line_id
 JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar r ON rl.return_date BETWEEN r.period_start_date AND r.period_end_date
 WHERE r.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND r.fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8 GROUP BY 1
)

FROM s JOIN rf ON rf.p=s.p ORDER BY 1
